subject: Conflicting reinforcement detail for the slab-on-deck pour strip between Structural

messages.text: The slab-on-deck pour strip reinforcement shown in Structural General Notes S-001 conflicts with #6 dowels at 12" o.c. noted in Foundation Plan S-101. We need an urgent response on this; please treat it as time-sensitive. This may generate a change order depending on the direction taken. This is not holding any current pour. We need direction by end of day Wednesday.

Proceed with #6 dowels at 12" o.c. per Foundation Plan S-101; Structural General Notes S-001 is superseded. This may generate a change order depending on the direction taken. This is not holding any current pour.
